chunks: And it is narrated from Naṣr al-Khādim, who said:

The righteous servant, Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, looked at a provision-cloth upon which there were brass rings, and said: "Remove these and place iron in their stead, for none of the creeping harmful creatures will come near anything in which there is something of it."

key_terms.الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ: the righteous servant, a title used here for the Imam
key_terms.حَدِيدًا: iron, specified here as the replacement material
key_terms.حَلَقُ: rings or loops attached to the item
key_terms.سُفْرَةٍ: a provision-cloth or food spread prepared for travel

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام recommend for protecting travel provisions from harmful creatures?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام instructed that brass rings on a travel provision-cloth be replaced with iron. It conveys a practical teaching connected to safeguarding provisions from harmful creeping creatures during travel.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2451 - It is narrated from Nasr, the servant, who said:

The righteous servant (of Allah (swt)), Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), looked at a provision container with brass rings and said:
"Remove these and replace them with iron, for nothing harmful will approach anything contained within it."
